nutrition_reference._about: Daily reference values for the weekly recap, from nutrition_guide.md 'Micronutrient Reference' (added 2026-10-08): standard adult-male DRI / FDA DV. Not targets; judged week to week at the checkpoint. min = at least, max = at most; show = how the recap prints it.

weight_rule._about: nutrition_guide.md 'Calories': after 2 consistent weeks, still losing/flat -> add 150-250 kcal/day; gaining ~0.25-0.75 lb/week -> stay; consistently >1 lb/week after the initial rebound -> reduce ~150-200 kcal. A consistent week = at least min_readings morning weigh-ins. Golden rule 3: a falling weekly average is always flagged.

weekly_template._about: Planned sessions per day, used to score the week and to answer 'what's today'. Codes: sport (a skill session: A Wed, B Fri, C Sat by default; any day counts), knee (the next of Session A/B; they alternate A -> B -> A regardless of day), upper (the next of Upper A/B; they alternate A -> B regardless of day, at least 2 days apart), pt, upperA, upperB (a specific upper session, for a week that names one), accessory, power, cond. The Tue knee session may run Wed. Weeks before a revision use weekly_template_history (each entry applies through its 'until' date).

daily_minimum._about: Weighted heel-prop rounds that make a full daily minimum (the floor) from a date on; fewer rounds score half. Log each round as floor_am / floor_pm = Y (floor_am for a single round, any time of day). rounds 0 = the heel prop is a weekly check (Sundays, logged as floor_am=Y that day) and the daily minimum is the graded morning check.

measurement_metrics._about: Metrics allowed in real/logs/measurements.csv (one row per side per measurement; a metric marked sided:false is measured once for the body and its row leaves side blank). lsi: 'higher' = L/R x 100 on the same date and method (higher is better); 'lower' = R/L x 100 (timed tests). label: the short name in views; now: shown in real/NOW.md's latest-measured line. target {low, high, source}: his own numbers for the look he wants, printed by `measures` and the trends page; a wish he set, never a dose or a gate (the plan's gates stay in rehab). The girths' landmarks and conditions are his guide, real/plan/measurement_guide.md (`doc tape`): first thing in the morning, tape snug, not compressing. standard {solid, very_good (the threshold numbers), solid_text, very_good_text (his table's words), better (higher/lower), basis (bw = x bodyweight, abs), reps [min, max], e1rm (a lift: load x reps -> Epley), opens (the rehab phase the test opens in), opens_why, source}: his performance standards (real/plan/performance_standards.md, `doc standards`), shown by `darrow.py standards`; occasional tests of his own, never sessions, doses or gates. Add a metric here before logging it.

Filmed at home, Sundays until it passes

sport.name: Ultimate

sport.target_return: late spring 2027, by the rehab gates; for a cutting and pivoting sport the master plan treats 9 months (2027-05-24) as a minimum reference, after the return-to-sport battery
sport.stage: Phase 4: standing throws with the feet planted and slight pivots on the planted foot within reason (Cody 10/15), on any day without a knee session (on an upper day after the bike, before lifting); one dial a week, throw count or intensity, not both; game-range long throws (<=~80%) from the planted stance; defense Level 2a. Not yet, each with the PT's OK for that drill: step-out throws, throwing on the move, marking; max intent waits for Phase 5 (sport_plan.md section 3; whole_athlete_addon.md section 3)

vocabulary._about: Allowed values of the log fields the engine scores or reads as a switch. `set`, `ex add`, `sport add` refuse anything else and `check` validates every row, so a misspelt code never silently changes XP or a tier (an unlisted word used to pay a full knee session). Case matters except where noted. Extend a list here when a new code is needed; free-text columns (notes, am_trend, am_notes, gait_notes, crutches, catch, conditioning_type, exercise, drill, metric) are not listed and not checked.

daily._knee_session: A/B (which session), min (the minimum session: a loaded day), home (a knee session logged by its rows), partial (below the minimum: not a loaded day; 'partial …' with a note after it is accepted)
daily._addon_session: one code, or several joined with + (upperA+accessory)

exercise._load_unit: the unit of `load`: lb (weights, a cable's or machine's stack number), plates (a machine's stack counted in plates), level (a bike's resistance). `load` itself is a number, or one per set (40/50/60); bands go in `band`, box and step heights in `height_in`

sport._session: case-insensitive: the engine reads a/b/c/film as A/B/C/FILM
